We’ve been so used to receiving a warm and friendly welcome in California, especially in smaller, local stores. Unfortunately, that wasn’t our experience here.

We were mostly ignored when we entered and weren’t approached or asked if we needed any help until we were already at the register. We were also a little disappointed by the selection and honestly wouldn’t have driven across the city specifically for it.

Having different expectations about the selection is one thing, but a friendly welcome and helpful staff can make such a big difference to the overall experience.

Unfortunately, we left feeling rather disappointed.

I want to begin by saying that my husband and I used Blue Collar even before they moved to their location on Glendale boulevard. They were kind, they were clean, and always very helpful with our old dogs. I went there Saturday with a new shelter dog we adopted, and as I arrived the dog was began to throw up. I pulled in and asked for help... Paper towel, cloth, a helping hand. Two of the three just stood there behind the counter and looked down. A third one walked over, Robert, and said I'll help. I looked at the other two and I said what is it... you don't help customers anymore? One of them replied we're not allowed to help you. We can't go outside. That's not our job. The lack of respect, and simple humankindness,  told me that I never ever have to give them business again. Robert came over to my car and helped me push the dog puke into their trash can. He gave me paper towels too. I then walked in to buy some dog treats and a harness, while the other two stayed behind the counter and looked down.
I said, oh now you can't even help show me the harnesses you sell? One of them reply oh I'm busy.  Pathetic.  Robert helped size our new dog for a harness and I picked out some treats too.  2 other customers came in, and the other slackers just stood behind the counter clerking their sales.

So hopefully you're like me and decide that you don't need to give this place any of your business. I try to support businesses in our hood, but I guess I'll just go to one of the bigger places like Petco... They actually take care of their customers and appreciate them. There was one other car in the lot, they were not busy, and YES this was last Saturday.

Great store. We drove 4 hours to check them out. They had a great selection.  Super clean. Our dog enjoyed exploring and picking out toys and treats ro bring home. Wish you guys were closer to us! We will definitely be back.
